races.paceDynamic: Lady Litigator will lead alone from the start with no other committed front runners to pressure her, allowing her to dictate comfortable fractions throughout. The prominent runners Rebel Tribesman, Crackalackin and Calibos will track her but this group lacks the quality to mount sustained pressure on the leader. The hold-up contingent including Kamille Au Kanada, Fervent and Shamsat will need Lady Litigator to weaken significantly to get involved from their patient tactics. This race strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can capitalize on the uncontested lead and soft pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lady Litigator Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Litigator maintains her jumping and stays strong to the line
scenarios.body: Her uncontested lead creates ideal conditions and the soft pace allows her to have plenty left for the finish. The hold-up horses face an impossible task against a leader who hasn't been softened up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Litigator weakens in the final half mile under pressure
scenarios.body: Rebel Tribesman and Crackalackin are perfectly positioned to strike when the leader falters, having tracked the modest pace without expending energy. Their recent form gives them the edge over the deeper hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stronger than expected and Lady Litigator ties up badly
scenarios.body: Kamille Au Kanada or Fervent could benefit from a genuinely run race that brings the field back to them. However, this requires the pace to be much faster than the lone leader setup suggests.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Litigator falls or makes a bad mistake at a crucial hurdle
scenarios.body: With the sole pace setter removed, the race becomes a sprint finish where any of the prominent racers could capitalize. This scenario relies on incident rather than tactical advantage.

races.paceDynamic: Pleasure Garden will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, with his prominent style and lowest weight (134lbs) allowing him to dictate terms unchallenged. The remaining five runners are all hold-up horses who will track behind in a congested pack, creating a tactical nightmare as they all need cover and room to maneuver. This setup produces a steady gallop early with all the drama compressed into the final 4-5 furlongs when the hold-up brigade must find racing room simultaneously. The lack of early pace pressure heavily favors the pace-setter and any horse that can get prominent early rather than relying on late finishing kicks from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Pleasure Garden maintains his lead unchallenged through steady fractions
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows him to conserve energy while the hold-up horses face a traffic jam turning for home, struggling to find clear runs when it matters. His 35-day break freshens him up while carrying just 134lbs against much heavier-weighted rivals.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get badly hampered in the straight when they all need racing room
scenarios.body: Multiple runners converge at once creating interference and blocked runs, allowing one or two to benefit from a clear passage while others are stopped in their tracks. The patient ride wins out over pure ability.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Pleasure Garden goes too fast early or gets headed before the turn
scenarios.body: The front runner's limitations are exposed when pressed, creating a more even contest where class and recent form become decisive factors. The race opens up for the better-handicapped hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses find clear runs simultaneously in a genuine sprint finish
scenarios.body: Despite the tactical disadvantage, sheer class and fitness tell as the better horses overcome the pace bias through superior acceleration. Racing Post Ratings become the deciding factor.
